command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 ai-core-node@100.70.87.28 'bash -s' <<'REMOTE_SCRIPT'
set -e
echo '=== identity ==='
hostname
id -un
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ
echo '=== unit status ==='
systemctl --user status frankenstein-local-bridge.service --no-pager -l || true
echo '=== unit cat ==='
systemctl --user cat frankenstein-local-bridge.service || true
echo '=== journal ==='
journalctl --user -u frankenstein-local-bridge.service -n 100 --no-pager || true
echo '=== processes ==='
pgrep -af 'local_bridge_daemon.py|clay-local-bridge/bin/daemon.py' || true
echo '=== bridge files ==='
ls -l ~/.claude/star/local_bridge_daemon.py ~/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/bin/daemon.py 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== state dirs ==='
ls -ld ~/.claude/star/local_bridge_state ~/.local/share/clay-local-bridge 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== git state ==='
for d in ~/.claude/star/local_bridge_state/repo ~/.local/share/clay-local-bridge/repo; do
  if [ -d "$d/.git" ]; then
    echo "--- $d"
    git -C "$d" remote -v || true
    git -C "$d" branch --show-current || true
    git -C "$d" status --short --branch || true
  fi
done
REMOTE_SCRIPT
